summary: Three high-leverage improvements: AI key protection via proxy, food database enrichment, engagement notification system.

deliverables.title: AI Key Protection — Cloudflare Worker Proxy
deliverables.description: Minimal Cloudflare Worker that proxies AI requests. API keys (Groq, Grok, OpenRouter) live server-side as encrypted Worker secrets. Client sends X-App-Key (shared secret) + X-Device-Id. Per-device rate limiting (60 req/min) via KV namespace. 64KB body cap, max_tokens capped at 2000.
security_improvements: API keys no longer ship in JS bundle
Request size limits prevent payload abuse
max_tokens server-side cap prevents cost explosion
deployment_steps: Update wrangler.toml with KV namespace ID
deliverables.notes: Dev-mode fallback: if proxy URL is not configured, aiProvider.ts falls back to direct provider calls using SecureStore keys (existing behavior). Zero breaking changes.

deliverables.title: Food Database Nutritional Enrichment
deliverables.description: All 861 food items now have complete nutritional data sourced from USDA FoodData Central reference values. Added calories_per_serving, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g to every item. Protein_g was already present for 830/861 items; remaining 31 items filled.
deliverables.interface_updated: RegionalFoodItem now includes carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g optional fields

deliverables.title: Engagement Notification System
deliverables.description: Three new engagement notification triggers alongside the existing daily workout reminder. All local (no push server). Smart cooldowns prevent notification fatigue.

notification_types.trigger: Last workout > 20h ago AND active streak > 0
notification_types.example: 🔥 5-Day Streak at Risk! Don't break the chain — a 10-minute session counts!
💪 3 Days Since Last Workout. Ready to restart? A short session today makes all the difference.
📊 Your Week in Review: 4 workouts, 28 exercises | 12-day streak. New week, new goals.

deliverables.integration: reconcileEngagementNotifications() called from _layout.tsx on app start, alongside existing reconcileNotificationReliability(). All triggers run in parallel with catch guards. Uses existing expo-notifications dependency.
deliverables.message_rotation: Messages rotate daily to prevent notification blindness (pool of 4 per type, selected by day-of-year).

constraint_violations_resolved.violation: API keys in client JS bundle via EXPO_PUBLIC_* env vars
constraint_violations_resolved.resolution: Proxy server holds keys server-side. Client sends only shared app-key.

constraint_violations_resolved.violation: Food database had 0/861 items with calorie data
constraint_violations_resolved.resolution: All 861 items enriched with USDA-sourced calories, carbs, fat, fiber.
3 engagement triggers (streak, inactivity, weekly summary) + app start reconciler.
